main:1.text: Black Mesa Inbound is the first chapter of Half-Life. No action is present in this Chapter at all, this Chapter serves as the introduction to Half-Life, with the tram announcement system giving the player a time, place, and general information about Black Mesa.

main:15.text: Xen (pronounced "zen" ) is the Borderworld, a plane of existence connecting two or more universes (which Xen can be referred to as).  It was discovered by Black Mesa research scientists, who regularly traveled there via teleportation to collect samples and study the myriad species of flora and fauna within, despite the extremely high risk of doing so.

main:18.text: Physically, the Nihilanth resembles a massive grayish-brown (pinkish under certain lighting conditions) fetus with abnormal proportions and a disproportionately large head perched atop a much smaller body. His tiny legs appear to be the remnants of an amputation, as the Nihilanth relies on a levitation device for mobility, a severe injury likely inflicted by the Combine.
